book.name: ROMANS
book.title: Paul ROME ep Tuptsiwni’yuṅqamuy amumi Pēniata

content: Please Others, Not Yourselves
Noqw ōviy itam tuptsiwnit aṅ ö’qalt qaöqáwi’yuṅqamuy amumi maqaptsi’yuṅwni, qa paysoq‐sa nāp itahtunatyay hinhtotini.
Itam sohsoyam itahsinosṅwamuy öqawhtotaniqat ōviy tunatyawyuṅwni.
Pi Christ pas nāp tunatyay hinhtiniqey qa pan tunatyawta, pi ura yan pey’ta: Umumiq hiṅqaqwaqamuy lavayiam inuhpe yēvaya. (Ura Christ Nay aw yan lavayhti.)
Pi hisat himu pēniwhqa itamuṅem pēniwa, itam put ahpiy hihta tutuqayyaniqat ōviy’o; noqw itam tutuvenit ahpiy öqalantiwye’ hūrs hoṅvani, nen God aw yanyuṅwni.
Nam God hakiy hihta aṅ kuyvanaṅwuk̇aṅw pu hakiy öqalaṅwuqa umuy sun unaṅwtoynani, Jesus Christ hin tunatyay’taqat pan’i.
Noqw uma sunwuwnit, pu sunlavayit akw God, Itahtutuyqawhqay Jesus Christ Nayat tayawnayani.
The Gospel to the Gentiles
Piw uma pās nāooyyani, Christ itamuy pās óyahqat pan’i, God pas hímunihqat ōviy’o.
Noqw nu umumi paṅqawni: Jesus Christ Jew‐sinmuy amumi lavay’aya, God pas qa atsátaqat mahtaknaniqee, pu itahwu’yamuy amumi hin pasiwhtaqat aw aṅ antsantaniqee.
Noqw ima qa‐Jew‐sinom God núokwayat ep put pas hihtatotani, pi ura yan pey’ta: Yaniqw ōviy nu qa‐Jew‐sinmuy amumi uṅ paṅqawni; nu uhnatṅwaniy aw tawlawni, yan’i.
Pu piw pam paṅqawu: Uma qa‐Jew‐sinom put sinomuyatuy amumum hahlayyani.
Pu piw yanwata: Uma Tutuyqawhqat tayawnayani, sohsoyam qa‐Jew‐sínomu; uma put aw hahlayyani, sinom sohsoyamu.
Pu piw Esaias yan lavayhti: Pay nāt Jesset ahpiy aniwhtiqa wunuptuni; nen pam qa‐Jew‐sinmuy amumi moṅw’iwtani; noqw qa‐Jew‐sinom put aw yanyuṅwni.
Nam God hakiy unaṅwvastoynaṅwuqa umuy hinhaqam hahlaytoyne’ umuy kwakwhat unaṅwtoynani, umuy put aw tūtuptsiwaq’ö. Nam pam umuy pās unaṅwvahsit huytani, Qahováriwtaqat Hiksit ahpiy’o.
Paul’s Reason for Writing So Boldly
Itupkomu, pas nu umuy qapēvewnaqw uma lolmat pas pasiwyuṅwa, pu itahtuptsiwniy sohsok tuwi’yuṅwa, pu uma nāö’qawnayaniqey pasiwyuṅwa.
Nīk̇aṅwo itupkomu, nu hihin qatuhtusk̇aṅw umumi penta, umuy ahoy hīhihta u’nananiqey tunatyawk̇aṅwo.

God nuy ōkwatuwhqe nuy qa‐Jew‐sinmuy Jesus Christ āawnaniqat ayata, nu God aṅqw lomatuawit yuaataniqat ōviy’o. Okiw as nu qa‐Jew‐sinmuyy put aw noaqw Qahováriwtaqa Hikwsi pumuy put aw sūpwataqw God put pantaqat ep hahlayni.
Noqw ōviy nu Jesus Christ amum God eṅem hihta tumaltaqey ep tsúyakiwtani.
Nen Christ inuhpiy hihta hintsakqat‐sa yuaatani; pam inuhpiy qa‐Jew‐sinmuy put aw tuqayvastotaniqat tumaltaq’ö. Pam lavayiy akw tumalta, pu hintsakpiy akw’a,
Pu k̇ātutmalat hihta tuawi’yuṅqat akw’a, God Hikwsiyat öqalayat ahpiy’o. Noqw ōviy nu Jerusalem‐kitsókit aṅqw Illyricum‐tutskwat aqw pahsavo lomatuawit Christ tuawi’taqat sohsok yuaayku.
Pu nu yan tunatyawta: Nu haqam Christ pay yuaatiwhqat qa pep lomatuawit yuaataniqeyu, taq k̇a nu pay hakiy kīyayhniyat ahpiy tukwtani.
Pay pi ura yan pey’ta: Hakimuy amumi qa āawnayaqw puma put nanaptani; pu put qa hisat nanaptaqam māmatsyani.
Paul’s Plan to Visit Rome
Yantaqw ōviy nu as piép umumiqniqey unaṅwtik̇aṅw itumalay akw sóontsaniwṅwu.
Noqw nu yepeq kurs pāpu haqaminiqey, pu nu as wūhaq yahsaṅwuy aṅ umumiqniqey tunatyawtaqe
Oviy ason nu hisat Spain aqwnen umumiqni; pay hisnen nu aqwnīk̇aṅw umumi as yórikniqey wūwanta; nen nu umumum hihsavo hahlayhq, pu nu paṅsoqniqw, uma nuy paaṅwayani.
Nīk̇aṅw nu nāt pay pu’ Jerusalem aqw hoyta, God sinomuyatuy hihta haqni’yuṅqat amuṅem yawmaniqey ōviy’o.
Pi ima Macedoniat pu Achaiat ep tuptsiwni’yuṅqam hihta o’yaniqey ep hahlayk̇ahk̇aṅw kuwahtoti, Jerusalem epeq God sinomuyatuy amuṅaqw aṅ okiwhinyuṅqamuy amuṅemi.

Puma hahlayhtoti, amumi yoniwyuṅqee, pi God Jew‐sinmuy amuhpiy qa‐Jew‐sinmuy lomatuawit āawnaqe pumuy ayo oya, soñawnen pumuy kuwahtiput huyta; noqw ōviy qa‐Jew‐sinom soon it qatsit ep hihta himuy’yuṅqey akw qa pumuy amumi unaṅwtapyani.
Noqw ōviy ason nu yan it iayaway an hinhte’ hihta oyiwhqat pumuy amumi noe’ pep pu’ nu umuhpa hinmak̇aṅw Spain aqwni.
Noqw it nu navoti’ta: Pas nu umumiq pite’ umuy Christ āawnaqw pam inuhpiy umuy pas pavan öqaltoynani.
Aw iunaṅwamu itupkomu, uma Jesus Christ aw tūtuptsiwhqe nānami unaṅway’yuṅwa, pan Hikwsit ahpiy tutuqayyaqee. Noqw ōviy nu umumi okiw paṅqawni: Uma qa nātusi’k̇ahk̇aṅw inuṅem God aw tūviṅtotani.
Noqw nu Judeat ep qatuptsiwni’yuṅqamuy amuṅaqw ayo taviwniqat uma inumum nāwakintotani, pu nu Jerusalem epeq sinmuy amuṅem hihta hinmaqat God sinomat pas pay okiw ömahtotani.
Noqw God pan tunatyawtaqw nu hahlayk̇aṅw umumiq pituni, nen umumum suyan unaṅwtini.
Taay, nam hakiy kwakwhat unaṅwtoynaṅwuqa God sohsokmuy umumum yantaa. Nam antani.
